## [behavior.md](behavior.md): Study plan progression rules (58 lines)

TrackProgress stores an index and doneOn date. Today's item advances the day after it was ticked; Skip and Previous move without marking done; the track wraps at the end.

## [operations.md](operations.md): Editing the study plan (36 lines)

Change lessons by editing Curriculum.kt and running build.sh. Reordering or removing items shifts saved index positions, since progress stores a position instead of a lesson id.
